headline: Sahara Group Builds 30,000-Tonne LPG Terminal in Mombasa, Kenya
summary: Energy conglomerate Sahara Group is constructing a 30,000-metric-tonne liquefied petroleum gas terminal in Mombasa, expanding its investment in cooking-gas supply infrastructure across East Africa.
why: Expanding LPG storage and import capacity in East Africa helps replace biomass fuels with cleaner household energy while reducing port demurrage costs.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: The construction of a large LPG terminal boosts regional fuel storage infrastructure and energy security.
